description:
Returns all External RFIs in the specified Project.
See [Filtering on List Actions](https://developers.procore.com/documentation/filtering-on-list-actions) for information on using the filtering capabilities provided by this endpoint.

parameters.name: filters[sync_status]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified External RFI Sync Status.

parameters.name: filters[connection_status]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified External RFI Connection Status.

parameters.name: filters[rfi_manager_id]
parameters.description: Returns item(s) with the specified External RFI's Manager ID.

parameters.name: filters[responsible_contractor_id]
parameters.description: Returns item(s) with the specified External RFI's Responsible Contractor ID.

parameters.name: filters[received_from_id]
parameters.description: Returns item(s) with the specified External RFI's Received From ID.

parameters.name: filters[due_date]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) that are due within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYY...

parameters.name: filters[time_resolved]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) that are due within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYY...

parameters.name: filters[initiated_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) that were Initiated within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offs...

parameters.name: filters[updated_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) last updated within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYY...

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Field to sort the External Rfi list by. If the field is passed with a prefixed '-' (Example: -position) it will be sorted in reverse order.
